title: Incorrect early return when cookie is present
detail: The code returns an empty ImmutableMultiDict when a cookie string is provided, skipping parsing. It should return an empty dict only when no cookie is present.
note: Says a present cookie returns an empty dict, which the planted `if cookie:` does.

title: Incorrect file data handling
detail: The original code skipped processing when the file pointer was None. The change inverts the condition, causing all non‑None file pointers to be skipped and valid file data never sent, leading to missing or corrupted uploads.
note: Says set file values are skipped, which the planted `is not None` does.

title: Breakpoint logic never executed
detail: The `_set_breakpoints` function is defined inside `_on_resize` but the calls that used to invoke it have been removed. As a result, breakpoint classes are never updated when the terminal is resized, breaking the intended style updates.
note: Says the calls of the helper were removed; nothing about the planted `and`.

title: Uncaught ModuleNotFoundError on missing vendor module
detail: The function now always returns a ModuleType by calling importlib.import_module without handling ImportError. If the requested vendor module is not present, importlib.import_module will raise ModuleNotFoundError, causing the entire debug command to crash instead of gracefully returning None or skipping the module.
